title: Shramyogi Cycle Subsidy Scheme- Gujarat Labour Welfare Board

scheme.name: Shramyogi Cycle Subsidy Scheme- Gujarat Labour Welfare Board
scheme.summary: Provide a subsidy for the purchase of a bicycle to laborers working in the organized sector, enabling them to commute between their residence and workplace.
eligibility: Labourers (Shramyogi) should be employed for the last one year in a factory/institute in the state of Gujarat.
Labourers who have been regularly contributing to the Labour Welfare Fund will be eligible for this scheme.
Assistance will be given only on the newly purchased cycle.
Application has to be made within 6 (six) months from the date mentioned in the bicycle purchase bill.
This scheme can be availed only once during the employment period.
scheme.benefits: Laborers will receive assistance of ₹1,500/- as a subsidy towards the purchase of a bicycle.
scheme.how_to_apply: Apply online through the Sanman Portal by registering with your Aadhaar Card Number and Labour Welfare Fund Account Number, filling out the application form, and uploading the required documents.
